reason: W403 (#465): the Lorenz equations at sigma=10, b=8/3 have a homoclinic orbit to the origin at r=13.926 (Sparrow 1982; Kaplan and Yorke 1979). Three dimensions: one unstable eigenvalue 7.13 and two stable (-18.13, -8/3), so HomCont's projection matters. The orbit starts from the unstable manifold's integration over 4.6 time units, which comes back toward the origin along the z axis; the curve in (r, b) continues it.

differences.cause: W566 (#631): docs/xppaut-findings.md finding 69: XPPAUT 8.0 samples the homoclinic start orbit with an unscaled interpolation weight (auto_nox.c:1765), so the starting data it continues from (its first point, which neither AUTO corrects) is not the integrated orbit: its first point's L2 norm is 7.102317, xppautX's 7.101925 (relative 5.5e-5). Traced, not declared equal: the later points agree within the tolerances, no tolerance is widened.
